summary: Paamiut Airport (JFR) is a small regional airport serving the coastal town of Paamiut on Greenland's southwestern coast, originally founded as the colonial settlement Frederikshåb. The facility connects this remote fishing and mining community to Nuuk and other Greenlandic settlements, with Air Greenland operating scheduled flights using STOL aircraft suited to the challenging Arctic conditions. Its short runway and modest infrastructure reflect the practical demands of serving Greenland's scattered coastal populations.
